mapper.insert: insert into pep_platform.app_user (username, password_hash, enabled, created_at, issuer, subject, display_name, state, tenant_id, updated_at) values (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, 'local', #{username}, #{username}, case when #{enabled} then 'ACTIVE' else 'DISABLED' end, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', now())
